t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"
for stamp in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do : > "$t/dest/demo-$stamp.tar.gz"; done
echo "--- rotate --help exits:"; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo $?
echo "--- rotate --keep=2 --dry-run:"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=2 --dry-run; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate --keep 0:"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate unknown flag:"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- rotate missing dest:"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/nope" --name demo 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- rotate positional arg rejected:"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo extra 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- verify --help exits:"; bash verify.sh --help >/dev/null; echo $?
echo "--- verify --name filter with space name:"
printf 'data\n' > "$t/dest/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
(cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256")
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name my; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify missing archive keeps BAD semantics:"
printf 'deadbeef  gone.tar.gz\n' > "$t/dest/gone.sha256"; bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" | grep BAD; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"

result:
All done — `bash tests/run_tests.sh` passes all 9 tests (6 existing + 3 new covering both bugs), and `--help`, `--keep=`, `--dry-run`, `--name`, unknown-flag and exit-code behavior all verified on the refactored scripts.

I changed `rotate.sh` (surplus was `tail -n +$keep` on an oldest-first list, deleting the newest; now `head -n $((total - keep))`, with early exit at `-le`), `verify.sh` (sidecar name was truncated at the first space by `awk '{print $2}'; now the digest is split off and the whole remainder of the line is kept as the file name), added `lib/common.sh` (shared option parser + `resolve_dir`, sourced by both), and added tests to `tests/run_tests.sh`.
